title: horizontal_ordinary_forward_fixed_pasting
statement: Let X,Y,S,T be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, f:X→Y a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism, g:S→Y and h:T→S arbitrary morphisms. Use the pinned derived pullback/direct-image adjunctions and ordinary QCoh base-change maps [def-pc-derived-base-change-map, lem-sc-duality-base-change-inverse-square-mate]. Put P=(X×_Y S)×_S T and Q=X×_Y T. Let e:P≅Q be the canonical iterated pullback isomorphism, p:P→T and q:Q→T the second projections, and u:Q→X the first projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write L(m)=qcPullback m and R(m)=qcDirectImage m for the restricted derived pullback and direct-image functors [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-sc-duality-base-change-inverse-square-mate]. Let s be horizontalOrdinaryUpperComparison f g h [def-sc-horizontal-ordinary-upper-comparison], b=horizontalOrdinaryBaseComparison g h [def-sc-horizontal-ordinary-base-comparison], and k=horizontalOrdinaryTransfer e q p using the second projection equation [def-sc-horizontal-ordinary-transfer]. Let β be qcBaseChange f (h≫g), and γ_E be qcPullback h applied to the first ordinary base-change component, followed by the second ordinary base-change component on the first upper pullback of E. For any supplied s′ and k′ equal to these constructed s and k, b.hom_(R(f)E)≫β_E=γ_E≫R(p)(s′.hom_E)≫k′_(L(u)E), for every E in D_QCoh(X). No base-change invertibility assumption is imposed.

theorem horizontal_ordinary_forward_fixed_pasting
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (h : Z ⟶ Y') :
    letI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback f (h ≫ g) : Scheme.{u}) :=
      quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))
    letI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h : Scheme.{u}) :=
      quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)
    let s := horizontalOrdinaryUpperComparison f g h
    let e := pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f g h
    let q := pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)
    let p := pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h
    let k := horizontalOrdinaryTransfer e q p (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd f g h)
    let β := qcBaseChange f (h ≫ g)
    let γ := fun E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ↦
      (qcPullback h).map ((qcBaseChange f g).app E) ≫
        (@qcBaseChange _ (pullback f g) Y' Z _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f g) _ _ h).app ((qcPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E)
    ∀ (s' : qcPullback (pullback.fst f g) ⋙
        qcPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h) ≅
        qcPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g)) ⋙ qcPullback e.hom)
      (k' : TwoSquare (horizontalMatePullback e.hom)
        (horizontalMatePushforward q) (horizontalMatePushforward p)
        (𝟭 (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z))),
      s' = s → k' = k → ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      (horizontalOrdinaryBaseComparison g h).hom.app ((qcDirectImage f).obj E) ≫
          β.app E =
        γ E ≫ (qcDirectImage p).map (s'.hom.app E) ≫
          k'.app ((qcPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))).obj E)
